episodes.prompt: sales.csv has one row per sale (date, region, product, units, unit_price). Region names are inconsistent in case and surrounding whitespace; treat them case-insensitively and trimmed, and report them in lowercase. Write report.json with exactly these keys: "total_revenue" (sum of units*unit_price over all rows), "by_region" (object mapping each region to its revenue), and "top_product" (the product with the highest total revenue). Round every money amount to 2 decimals.
